title: AI Voice Clone Emergency
tagline: An unknown number plays a panicked voice sounding like a relative asking for urgent UPI cash.
intro: An unfamiliar number ({{maskedPhone}}) plays a panicked voice sounding like {{relativeRole}} begging for ₹{{amount}} via {{scammerVpa}} right now. Stay calm and verify through their real saved number.

payloadTemplate.body: Please hurry, my phone broke and I met with a minor accident! Send ₹{{amount}} right now to {{scammerVpa}}—don't call my old number, it's switched off!

steps.label: Hang up and verify on {{relativeRole}}'s saved number
steps.cue: Hang up or verify out-of-band on {{relativeRole}}'s real saved contact instead of sending money to a stranger's UPI.
steps.explanation: AI voice cloning only needs seconds of public audio. Calling the saved contact directly exposes the impersonation immediately.

steps.label: Confirm your {{bankName}} balance remained untouched
steps.cue: After confirming {{relativeRole}} is safe on their real number, double-check your balance.
steps.explanation: Verifying your balance reassures you that zero funds were transferred before checking out-of-band.

steps.label: Block {{maskedPhone}} and report to 1930
steps.cue: Submit the caller number and {{scammerVpa}} so telecom and bank teams can block them.
steps.explanation: Reporting emergency impersonation numbers and mule VPAs prevents others in your family from being targeted.

props.title: Incoming Emergency Call
props.transcript: Please hurry, my phone broke and I met with a minor accident! Send ₹{{amount}} right now to {{scammerVpa}}—don't call my old number, it's switched off!

extraActions.label: Hang up & call {{relativeRole}}'s real saved number

trapIntents.ANSWER_CALL: Staying on the unknown line lets the scammer keep up emotional panic so you don't call {{relativeRole}}'s saved number.
trapIntents.ACCEPT_COLLECT: Sending ₹{{amount}} to an unverified VPA ({{scammerVpa}}) during an emotional rush is irreversible once settled.

props.note: {{relativeRole}} confirmed safe on their real saved number. Your ₹{{balance}} balance is untouched.

trapIntents.ACCEPT_COLLECT: You already confirmed {{relativeRole}} is safe—never send money to {{scammerVpa}}.

props.title: Report Voice Clone Scam
props.intro: Block {{maskedPhone}} and report the impersonation handle {{scammerVpa}} to 1930.

critical.title: You rushed a UPI transfer to an unverified emergency caller
critical.explanation: Voice-clone scams mimic a panicked loved one from a strange number and beg you NOT to call their old phone while pushing a third-party VPA ({{scammerVpa}}). Always hang up and call their saved contact first.
critical.reason: You rushed an emergency transfer without out-of-band verification last time, so practise verifying saved numbers next.

redFlags.label: Third-party VPA under urgency
redFlags.explanation: Scammers demand instant transfers to unrelated third-party UPI handles.

redFlags.label: Blocking verification callback
redFlags.explanation: Telling you not to call their real saved number stops you from discovering the clone.

redFlags.label: Excuse for unknown number
redFlags.explanation: A classic pretext explaining why the voice comes from an unrecognised number.

hints.verify-emergency-call: Hang up or tap 'Hang up & call {{relativeRole}}'s real saved number' to verify out-of-band.
hints.confirm-balance-safe: Review your balance to verify nothing was sent, then continue to report.
hints.report-voice-scam: Select an impersonation reason and submit the report to block {{maskedPhone}}.
